For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Shivendra Prasad, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mrs.Asha Devi, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE KHATIM REZA  ORAL ORDER 2 04-12-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
2. The petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with Tekari PS case No. 180 of 2024, dated 26-04-2024 instituted under Sections 341, 323, 498A, 504 and 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code 3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is the husband of the opposite party no.2.
He is ready to keep the opposite party no. 2 with full dignity and honour.
4. Issue notice to opposite party no. 2, both under speed post with A.D. as well as ordinary process for which requisites etc. must be filed within one week from today.

Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.80981 of 2024(2) dt.04-12-2024 5.
The case be listed upon service of notice or appearance of the opposite party no. 2, whichever is earlier among the top five cases.
6. In the meanwhile, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner in connection with Tekari PS case No. 180 of 2024, pending in the Court of the ACJM IV Gaya.
